description: This file defines the interface IGrainDirectoryResolver, which provides a method to resolve and retrieve an IGrainDirectory instance associated with a specific GrainType within the Orleans framework. It includes a single method TryResolveGrainDirectory that attempts to resolve the directory based on provided grain type and properties.

methods.name: TryResolveGrainDirectory
methods.description: Attempts to resolve and retrieve the IGrainDirectory associated with a specific GrainType. Returns true if successful, false otherwise.

parameters.grainType: The type of grain to resolve.
parameters.grainDirectory: Output parameter that receives the resolved IGrainDirectory if successful.
